name: Chronograph complication
summary: A watch mechanism that starts, stops and resets a timing hand with pushers, apart from the hands that show the time of day.
how: Fit a start and stop pusher and a reset pusher to the case.
Drive a central seconds hand and sub dials for minutes and hours from a clutch.
Print a tachymeter scale on the bezel to turn a time over a set distance into a speed.

origin.note: Louis Moinet builds the first chronograph to time the stars.

adoptions.via: The Speedmaster carries two pushers, three sub dials and a tachymeter bezel, to time laps and measure speed.
